name: voices
description: Create reusable voices, audition speech and keep exact performances on your Apple Silicon Mac with your own local Voices CLI and models.

interface.longDescription: Design reusable voices, review recordings, compare lines and save the performance you chose as WAV with provenance. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac, a separately installed Voices CLI and Qwen/MLX models. Model terms and disk/unified-memory requirements apply separately; no minimum-memory configuration has been qualified. This plugin supplies agent guidance, not a runtime or cloud service. Installation starts no inference or recording. Removal preserves your CLI, models and audio and leaves any running studio under its terminal's control.
defaultPrompt: Use Voices to inspect my local studio and find a suitable saved narrator.
Use Voices to create an original voice and save a speech performance I choose.
